description:
He ditched his smartphone for three months, went to an isolated cabin by the sea, and well, he still couldn't finish a single chapter of a book.

That's how Stolen Focus by Johann Hari opens — and it's the state of millions of us.

A complete breakdown of "Stolen Focus: Why You Can't Pay Attention — and How to Think Deeply Again" — the real causes of the attention crisis, the science behind flow, sleep and mind-wandering, the business models engineered to fragment you, and the honest criticism of Hari's own thesis.

Best for readers studying Stolen Focus for class or a book club, and anyone who wants the real takeaway — spoilers included.
